headlines.headline: SEC BARS PLAYERS WITH PRIOR NBA CONTRACTS AS ARIZONA LANDS TRANSFER RJ GODFREY
headlines.detail: The SEC adopted a new policy barring any player who signed an NBA contract from joining a member school, tied to the NCAA's looming 5-in-5 eligibility model, while Arizona added former Clemson forward RJ Godfrey out of the portal.

headlines.headline: TIMBERWOLVES ENGINEER TRADE TO FINALIZE JONATHAN KUMINGA SIGNING
headlines.detail: Minnesota traded Josh Green's $14.7M expiring deal and cash to Utah for Cody Williams and John Konchar, immediately stretching Konchar, to duck below the tax apron and complete Kuminga's two-year, $12.4M contract.

headlines.headline: LEAGUE HITS SUNDAY'S 6 P.M. ET DEADLINE TO CUT DOWN TO 53-MAN ROSTERS
headlines.detail: All 32 teams trimmed from 90 to 53 players; the Seahawks waived WR Julian Hicks, released S Rodney Thomas II, and cut sixth-rounder Emmanuel Henderson Jr. Waiver claims are due Monday at 1 p.m. ET.

headlines.headline: STANFORD OPENS SEASON WITH WALK-OFF SCOOP-AND-SCORE TO BEAT HAWAII
headlines.detail: Stanford capped Week 0's opening slate with a scoop-and-score touchdown in the final two minutes to beat Hawaii, following North Carolina's upset of TCU in Dublin and USC's rout of San Jose State.
